item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Jun 14 - 20, 2026)
item.description: A week heavy on local LLM coding setups, token-trimming tooling, dotfile managers, ZFS self-hosting, and a couple of supply-chain security reminders. Local AI & Coding Agents Running local models is good now / Ask HN: Has anyone replaced Claude/GPT with a local model?: Vicki Boykis argues local agentic coding has become genuinely good over the past few months, alongside the Hacker News thread of people sharing their daily-driver local setups. How to Setup a Local Coding Agent on macOS: Running Gemma 4 26B-A4B and Qwen3.
